name: CiviCRM
description: Open source constituent relationship management system for nonprofits, NGOs, and advocacy groups.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      CIVICRM_DSN: "mysql://civicrm:{{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-mariadb:3306/civicrm"
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/var/www/html/sites/default/files
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: civicrm
      MYSQL_USER: civicrm
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
